name: guided_intake_noncommercial_handoff
description: The GUIDED front door (doc 40), a population Phase 1 does not carry: an Original Medicare card. A card alone is medium-confidence evidence, so the planner ASKS (infer first, then ask) — the plain coverage-type screen — and on 'Medicare' exits with ONE honest line and hands off to the chat-first flow. No dead end, no half-built branch, and the case stays open. Needs --intake-mode guided.

intake.expect_copy_contains: For Medicare, I check your bill in our chat.
